**Coordinates.** Let B = (0,0), C = (7,0). Then A = (5/7, 20√3/7), F = (5/7, 0), and P = (5/7, p) with 0 < p < h, where h = 20√3/7.

**Step 1: Shared center height.** Both ω₁ and ω₂ pass through A and P, which lie on the vertical line x = 5/7. Their centers O₁ = (u, k) and O₂ = (v, k) therefore share the height k = (h+p)/2.

**Step 2: Parallel condition.** X is the reflection of A across line O₁B′, and Y is the reflection of A across line O₂C′. If X, Y, A are collinear, both AX and AY are perpendicular to the same line, so O₁B′ ∥ O₂C′. With B′ = (2u, 0) and C′ = (2v−7, 0), this gives u/k = (v−7)/k, so v = u + 7.

**Step 3: Solve.** Passing through B gives u = (7/10)(25/49 − Q). Passing through C gives v = (7/88)(49 − 25/49 + Q). Here Q = 2kp − p² = hp. Substituting v = u + 7 yields Q = 220/49, so hp = 220/49.

**Step 4: Finish.** p = (220/49)/(20√3/7) = 11√3/21, so

PA = h − p = 20√3/7 − 11√3/21 = 49√3/21 = **7√3/3**.
